intro.title: Color Choice Mixer
intro.subtitle: Mix seven color choices and see the count
intro.boundary: This author-created activity summarizes these choices only. It does not measure personality, emotion, compatibility, or health.

phase1.prompt1: What color is your morning energy?
phase1.prompt2: What color is your comfort zone?

result.method: Each spectrum choice adds one point to the nearest named hue; low-saturation choices count as white. Each palette displays the color that receives one point. The highest count is shown; ties use the listed color order.
result.boundary: This is a summary of seven choices, not a personality test or a claim about behavior, mood, compatibility, or ability.

share.text: Mix seven color choices and review the transparent count.
